text: Read both collections: cfd/20261117-1 collect-1 (clone, 178 calls, drafts under /tmp/fenicsx-drafts, clone gate PASS at 3b78b6c) and cfd/20261117-14 collect-1 (bundle alone, series_maximum@v1 run once). Both runs may be wiped. In the design role's paths: cfd-4 landed in 9927906 (TMPDIR, TMP and TEMP inside the run; trials under TMPDIR in meta_agent/CLAUDE.md); cfd-5 landed in 9954f02 (classify-knowledge: a quantity defined up to a constant is compared only after both share its zero). cfd-3 is open, beside ctrl-pair-4: the rule for what an interface task may do in the builder's tree is not settled. cfd-12 is put to the person with the blind-test question: the command-line claude has --setting-sources and --strict-mcp-config, which might keep a session from the account's skills and plugins, but that is not verified, and it changes what earlier runs were given. On the effort, the collection and the session record are the record, not the session's own words. Handed back to a meta seat, as each line's whose says: cfd-2 (one error contract per category, with dft-2), cfd-10 (the bundle's text), cfd-11 (a date with its time zone, or the computer's local date), and cfd-7. On cfd-7 the design role reads the rule of 2026-11-17 as you do: a scientific task's agreement decides pass or fail, so it is a quantity a library skill computes through the runner, named in the task, and validate_tasks.py reads it rather than computing it.
